65:     #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
66:     pub fn new(
67:         root_run_id: String,
68:         executing_run_id: String,
69:         owner_id: String,
70:         principal_id: String,
71:         workspace: String,
72:         runtime_epoch: String,
73:         artifact: &AgentArtifact,
74:         policy: &EffectiveRunPolicy,
75:         governance_policy_revision: String,
76:         host: HostAdmissionBinding,
77:     ) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
78:         let catalog_revision = artifact.catalog_metadata().map_or_else(
79:             || artifact.definition_revision(),
80:             |metadata| metadata.revision,
81:         );
82:         let run_policy_revision = digest_json(&serde_json::to_value(policy)?);
83:         let grant_revision = digest_json(&serde_json::json!({
84:             "tools": &policy.tools,
85:             "mcpServers": &policy.mcp_servers,
86:             "toolApproval": policy.tool_approval,
87:         }));
88:         let lease_revision = digest_json(&serde_json::json!({
89:             "rootRunId": &root_run_id,
90:             "executingRunId": &executing_run_id,
91:             "ownerId": &owner_id,
92:             "workspace": &workspace,
93:             "runtimeEpoch": &runtime_epoch,
94:             "hostEpoch": &host.host_epoch,
95:         }));
96:         let budget_revision =
97:             digest_json(artifact.extensions.get("budgets").unwrap_or(&Value::Null));
98:         let authority_ttl = artifact
99:             .extensions
100:             .get("budgets")
101:             .and_then(|value| value.get("timeout_seconds"))
102:             .and_then(Value::as_u64)
103:             .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_EFFECT_AUTHORITY_TTL_SECONDS);
104:         let budget_expires_at = expiry_from_now(authority_ttl)?;
105:         let lease_id = format!("uar-lease:{}", Uuid::new_v4());
106:         let budget_id = format!("uar-budget:{root_run_id}");
107:         Ok(Self {
108:             root_run_id,
109:             executing_run_id,
110:             owner_id,
111:             principal_id,
112:             workspace,
113:             runtime_epoch,
114:             catalog_revision,
115:             run_policy_revision,
116:             governance_policy_revision,
117:             grant_revision,
118:             lease_revision,
119:             budget_revision,
120:             lease_id,
121:             lease_expires_at: budget_expires_at,
122:             budget_id,
123:             budget_expires_at,
124:             host,
125:         })
126:     }

128:     /// Build the explicit authority envelope for an authenticated direct host
129:     /// call. This path has no agent artifact, delegated grant, or inherited
130:     /// budget; those absences are bound as named revisions rather than implied.
131:     pub fn direct(
132:         owner_id: String,
133:         principal_id: String,
134:         workspace: String,
135:         runtime_epoch: String,
136:         catalog_revision: String,
137:         governance_policy_revision: String,
138:         host: HostAdmissionBinding,
139:     ) -> Self {
140:         let run_id = format!("direct:{}", Uuid::new_v4());
141:         let lease_revision = digest_json(&serde_json::json!({
142:             "runId": &run_id,
143:             "ownerId": &owner_id,
144:             "workspace": &workspace,
145:             "runtimeEpoch": &runtime_epoch,
146:             "hostEpoch": &host.host_epoch,
147:         }));
148:         let grant_revision = digest_json(&serde_json::json!({
149:             "kind": "authenticated_direct_host",
150:             "ownerId": &owner_id,
151:             "principalId": &principal_id,
152:         }));
153:         let lease_id = format!("uar-lease:direct:{}", Uuid::new_v4());
154:         let budget_id = format!("uar-budget:{run_id}");
155:         let expires_at = default_effect_authority_expiry();
156:         Self {
157:             root_run_id: run_id.clone(),
158:             executing_run_id: run_id,
159:             owner_id,
160:             principal_id,
161:             workspace,
162:             runtime_epoch,
163:             catalog_revision,
164:             run_policy_revision: "direct:host".to_string(),
165:             governance_policy_revision,
166:             grant_revision,
167:             lease_revision,
168:             budget_revision: digest_json(&serde_json::json!({"kind": "direct:no_budget"})),
169:             lease_id,
170:             lease_expires_at: expires_at,
171:             budget_id,
172:             budget_expires_at: expires_at,
173:             host,
174:         }
175:     }
